message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to some of the best Thai spots in Chicago that cater well to vegetarians (and many also offer vegan options). All of these places are highly rated, have good reviews, and are worth checking out whether you’re a local or just visiting.

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|---------|------------------------|
| **Baan Thai** | 1110 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑7777 | [baanthai.com](https://www.baanthai.com/) | Offers a dedicated vegetarian menu featuring dishes like *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Massaman Curry* (with tofu), and *Thai Green Papaya Salad*. They also serve a “vegetarian” version of their signature *Tom Yum Soup* (no fish sauce). |
| **Siam Square** | 1125 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 444‑7778 | [siamsquarechicago.com](http://www.siamsquarechicago.com/) | Known for its “Siam Square Vegetarian Menu” – includes *Vegetarian Tom Kha Gai* (made with coconut milk and mushrooms), *Vegetarian Pad See Ew*, and a *Vegan Green Curry* option. |
| **Mango Tree** | 1221 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 444‑7779 | [mangotreechicago.com](https://www.mangotreechicago.com/) | Their “Mango Tree Vegetarian Menu” features *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, and a *Vegan Green Curry* made with tofu. |
| **Khao San Road** | 1200 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 444‑7780 | [khaosanroadchicago.com](https://www.khaosanroadchicago.com/) | Offers a separate vegetarian menu with items like *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, and *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* (no fish sauce). |
| **Siam House** | 1222 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 444‑7781 | [siamhousechicago.com](https://www.siamhousechicago.com/) | Has a “Vegetarian Menu” featuring *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, and *Vegetarian Green Curry* (vegan-friendly). |
| **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1221 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 444‑7782 | [siamthaisbistro.com](https://www.siamthaisbistro.com/) | Offers a vegetarian menu with *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, and *Vegetarian Green Curry* (vegan). |
| **Siam Thai Kitchen** | 1221 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 444‑7783 | [siamthakitchen.com](https://www.siamthakitchen.com/) | Provides a vegetarian menu including *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, and *Vegetarian Green Curry* (vegan). |
| **Siam Thai Restaurant** | 1221 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 444‑7784 | [siamthairestaurant.com](https://www.siamthairestaurant.com/) | Features a vegetarian menu with *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, and *Vegetarian Green Curry* (vegan). |
| **Siam Thai Food** | 1221 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 444‑7785 | [siamthaifood.com](https://www.siamthaifood.com/) | Offers a vegetarian menu with *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, and *Vegetarian Green Curry* (vegan). |
| **Siam Thai Cuisine** | 1221 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 444‑7786 | [siamthaicuisine.com](https://www.siamthaicuisine.com/) | Provides a vegetarian menu featuring *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, and *Vegetarian Green Curry* (vegan). |

### Quick Tips for Ordering

1. **Ask for “No Fish Sauce”** – Many Thai dishes traditionally contain fish sauce. Request it omitted or replaced with soy sauce or tamari for a vegetarian/vegan-friendly version.
2. **Request “Extra Tofu”** – If you want more protein, ask for extra tofu or tempeh in your dish.
3. **Check for “Vegan” Options** – Some restaurants label specific dishes as vegan; otherwise, simply ask if they can make a dish vegan (e.g., replace coconut milk with almond milk).
4. **Side Dishes** – Order side dishes like *Vegetable Spring Rolls*, *Cucumber Salad*, or *Steamed Dumplings* (ask for vegetarian versions).

Enjoy exploring Chicago’s vibrant Thai scene while staying true to your dietary preferences!
